newsitem.title: USA: Dow resumes choppy ways, dips back near lows.
newsitem.headline: Dow resumes choppy ways, dips back near lows.

text.p: U.S. blue chips turned lower in afternoon trading, again displaying the choppy pattern that has characterized late session trading in recent weeks.
The Dow was down 65 points at 7161 with declining issues pushing to a three-to-two lead over advancers on NYSE volume of about 375 million shares.
A weak bond market continued to weigh on stocks. The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury slipped 24/32 to yield 6.95 percent.
"We don't believe the stock market is out of the woods yet," said Charles White, managing director at Avatar Associates. "We'd certainly like to see the interest rate environment act better."
